skills.name: NVD feed sync habit
skills.description: Track new CVEs for your stack.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify your key products (file.read inventory).
2. web.search recent CVEs weekly.
3. Filter by version applicability (python.run_file).
4. Queue for triage (cat_tool_triage_queue).
5. Summarize deltas.

skills.name: Advisory diff review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Re-fetch key advisories periodically (web.crawl).
2. Diff against saved copies (python.run_file).
3. Flag scope/version changes.
4. Update the register.
5. Note regressions.

skills.name: PoC changelog watch
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Bookmark key PoC repos (notes file).
2. web.search for updates periodically.
3. Diff changed files (process.exec diff).
4. Re-triage (cat_res_poc_triage).
5. Update the library.

skills.name: CWE deep dive
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search the CWE page.
2. Collect detection and mitigation guidance (file.write).
3. Map to your codebase patterns (file.search).
4. Propose scans.
5. Teach the team.

skills.name: Attacker simulation notes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick an adversary profile (web.search reports).
2. Map their TTPs to your controls (file.write).
3. Plan safe emulations (lab/scope).
4. Execute the safest subset.
5. Report coverage.

skills.name: Detection gap scan
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List detection sources (file.write inventory).
2. Map attack paths to sources (python.run_file).
3. Flag uncovered paths.
4. Propose new detections.
5. Track closure.

skills.name: Lab network design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Draft topology (file.write).
2. Verify isolation rules.
3. Provision targets (cat_tool2_env_provision).
4. Snapshot the baseline.
5. Document.

skills.name: PoC license audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Record license per PoC (file.write index).
2. Flag restrictive ones.
3. Respect terms in reuse.
4. Clean incompatible items.
5. Review quarterly.

skills.name: Vulnerability economics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search exploit market reporting (conceptual).
2. Note factors driving prices/demand.
3. Relate to your assets' platforms.
4. Adjust prioritization.
5. Cite sources.

skills.name: Disclosure case studies
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick a notable case (web.search).
2. Summarize timeline and outcomes (file.write).
3. Extract lessons for your process.
4. Share internally.
5. Update playbooks.

skills.name: Log pipeline hygiene
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Inventory log destinations (file.write).
2. Verify redaction at each hop (python.run_file scans).
3. Check retention windows.
4. Fix leaks.
5. Document flow.

skills.name: CI secret scanning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Choose patterns (python.run_file list).
2. Wire scan step (doc/config).
3. Test with a fake secret.
4. Block merges on hits.
5. Document.

skills.name: SBOM generation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Generate from manifests (python.run_file).
2. Include licenses.
3. Publish with releases.
4. Use for advisory matching (cat_res2_nvd_feed_sync).
5. Keep fresh.

skills.name: Merge gate policy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Policy file: what blocks merges (file.write).
2. Automate checks (scans).
3. Track override reasons.
4. Review policy quarterly.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Performance regression CI
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Benchmark harness per key flow (python.run_file).
2. Run on changes.
3. Compare to baseline (file.read).
4. Flag regressions.
5. Track trends.

skills.name: Feature risk review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read the design (file.read).
2. Threat-model quickly (cat_ctf_threat_model_basics).
3. List security tasks.
4. Attach to the ticket.
5. Review pre-merge.

skills.name: On-call runbook
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Per-service runbooks (file.write).
2. Alert-to-action mappings.
3. Escalation contacts.
4. Drill quarterly.
5. Keep updated.

skills.name: Incident communications
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Templates: internal update, customer note (file.write).
2. Facts-only, no speculation.
3. Update cadence agreed.
4. Post-mortem link.
5. Archive.

skills.name: Scan type selection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Known value -> exact scan.
2. Unknown -> unknown-scan then refine (cat_mem_scan_value).
3. Float suspects -> float scan.
4. Document choice and outcome.
5. Learn per game.

skills.name: Region shortlisting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.regions; classify (cat_mem_region_map).
2. Prefer heap/anon RW.
3. Exclude file-backed code.
4. Record shortlist.
5. Scan.

skills.name: Value validation ritual
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.read target.
2. Change in-game once; re-read.
3. Only write after 2 confirmations.
4. Snapshot originals (cat_mem_value_snapshots).
5. Write.

skills.name: Post-write monitoring
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. After mem.write, re-read periodically (python.run_file loop).
2. Note rollback timing (server sync vs local).
3. Stop if integrity checks trigger (logcat).
4. Document.
5. Adjust strategy.

skills.name: Memory session cleanup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Restore original values (mem.write originals).
2. Verify in-game normal state (mem.visual.verify).
3. Remove temp scripts (file.delete).
4. Log the session summary (file.write).
5. Close.

skills.name: Multi-instance safety
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.process.list; disambiguate by pid age/user.
2. Pin the pid in session notes.
3. Guard writes with pid check (mem3 flow).
4. Abort on pid change.
5. Report.
